# Orvio 0.24

- Movies and Series open on titles with artwork first. Provider files without a poster no longer fill the top of the list.
- Video badges show the frame rate on phone and Android TV, measured from playback when the stream does not report it.
- Android TV: Back from a list returns to the selected category, even when it was scrolled out of view.
- Collections keep the same order when opening a title and going back.
- Home: "Clear list" for Recently watched, reachable with the remote.
